title: Create a Non-Clustered Index
description: Create a non-clustered index to speed up a common filter query.

data.text: You frequently run this query: SELECT * FROM Employees WHERE Department = 'Engineering' AND Salary > 80000. Create a non-clustered index to optimize it.

data.title: SQL Solution
Explanation
data.text: Index key columns (Department, Salary) go first and are used for filtering/sorting. INCLUDE columns (FirstName, LastName, HireDate) are stored in the leaf level but not in the index tree — they make the index covering (eliminating a lookup to the base table). Order key columns by selectivity.
